notes.title: Cognition Method won the "Best Unity game '21" Award at Indie Cap!
notes.notes:
"A first-person puzzle game set in an Escher-like world of impossible spaces.
You can walk on walls and change gravity on click. The authors also plan to tell an interesting story, for which they were inspired by Solaris and A Space Odyssey."
                                                                                                          -Indie Cup

 Please don't forget to subscribe and add the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1636620/Cognition_Method/]full game[/url] to the wishlist!

notes.title: Cognition Method
notes.notes:
Ground Control, we have an announcement to make! Cognition Method (full game) now has a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1636620/Cognition_Method/][b]Steam Page[/b][/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1636620

  What is being developed here is an incredible adventure that is bound to leave great memories.
  New puzzles featuring exciting gravity-altering experiments and unexpected solutions,
  A story about a vanished expedition and a mystical artifact,
  and bizzare atmosphere in the best traditions of science fiction genre will not leave you indifferent.
  
  We are making this game together with you - thank you for leaving feedback on the demo!

  Join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/QWZE6KUfMb]discord server[/url][/b] to be the first to know all the news about the upcoming game.

  Please add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1636620/Cognition_Method/][b]wishlist[/b][/url] and follow us on [b][url=https://twitter.com/CognitionMethod]Twitter[/url][/b] to be up to date.

notes.title: Patch 0.2
notes.notes:
With the help of our community, we improved the dialogue and added Russian and Polish localization to the game.
Your reviews and feedback are inspire us to make the game better. Our players deserve a good game and we will do our best to ensure they get it.
Stay with us and stay tuned for the future announcements! (something is coming)

[b] Patch 0.2[/b]
[list]
[*]  improved dialogue
[*]  fixed bugs
[*]  Russian localization
[*]  Polish localization
[/list]

We will add more languages with the next updates. Enjoy playing and have a good week!

notes.title: RELEASE DAY!
notes.notes:
We released the demo prologue of Cognition Method for free, in order to get your feedback
and introduce you to the universe we are working on. Download Cognition Method: Initiation now and let us know what you think. Thank you and enjoy!
